title.en: An Act to Authorize the Board of Regents of the University of the Philippines to Dispose of the Matriculation Fees Accruing to the University for the Current Operating Expenses of the Institution.
title.orig: An Act to Authorize the Board of Regents of the University of the Philippines to Dispose of the Matriculation Fees Accruing to the University for the Current Operating Expenses of the Institution.

text.en:
The provisions of law to the contrary notwithstanding, the Board of Regents of the University of
the Philippines is hereby authorized to spend all matriculation fees accruing or which have already accrued to
the University, including all such sums of the building fund as have not been heretofore obligated, for the
current operating expenses of the corresponding colleges and schools thereof.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, December 6, 1932.
